protocol: Keep the first eight ordered CPU jobs from each of the two held-out width-two layer batches, their production packed weights, seeded activations and five pinned workers with a reserved caller. Allocate four identical copies in each process. Compare reusing one copy with reading each copy in turn across four otherwise identical submissions. Validate actual work, exact serial outputs, guards, and observed worker rows and calls outside the timed processes. Three counterbalanced independent pairs per format, with the existing five scored batches per process and no CPU service observer. Report whole-pass and gate/up times separately and retain every pair, including mixed or flat results. This tests address reuse sensitivity of the fixed work. Dynamic claim timing and physical DRAM bytes are separate questions, and the component does not qualify a model speedup.
